because: The condition reports are the museum's working papers on its objects, not part of the online catalogue.
The register is the museum's catalogue of the objects the photographs show, so it describes the photographs' items.
The Classification column is how the museum groups its collection, and each classification is a set.
note: The deaccessioned object, the two part-lettered rows and the misnamed view are handled one by one as decisions in the frozen plan, not as edits: no edit kind names one row or one file.
